dedupe_keys.name: ais records from eleven ports around the globe october 2023

description: This Mendeley Data deposit holds Automatic Identification System records collected through the AISStream.io API for the whole of October 2023 at eleven ports: Singapore, Busan, Antwerp, Los Angeles, Southampton, Auckland, Livorno, Cape Town, Gdansk, Limassol and Algeciras. The authors, Andreas Hadjipieris, Neofytos Dimitriou and Ognjen Arandjelovic, used it to develop an automatic method for locating berths from vessel movements, and vessel identifiers are anonymised for privacy. Coverage is one month at position-report resolution around each port. The record offers a free download under CC BY 4.0, published on 25 July 2025, and the file format is not stated on the page read. Caveats: only one month and eleven ports, coverage depends on the terrestrial receivers behind AISStream, and anonymised identifiers prevent vessel-level joins. It suits port capacity planning, berth utilisation and congestion simulation. Related catalogue record: data-aishub-ais-data-exchange is a broader AIS data exchange.
